title: StableHand: Quality-Aware Flow Matching for World-Space Dual-Hand Motion Estimation from Egocentric Video
abstract: arXiv:2605.18553v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recovering world space 4D motion of two interacting hands from egocentric video is a fundamental capability for supervising robot policy learning, where wrist trajectories track the end-effector and finger articulations specify the grasp pose. Two major challenges arise in this setting: hands frequently leave the camera view for extended periods due to head motion, and persistent hand-object interactions cause severe occlusions of one or both hands. Existing methods uniformly condition on noisy hand motion observations without accounting for their per-frame reliability, leading to substantial performance degradation. Our key insight is that accurate world space hand motion estimation is tightly coupled with the quality of per-frame hand observations. translated_title: StableHand：基于质量感知流匹配的第一视角视频世界坐标系双手运动估计
translated_abstract: 从第一人称（自我中心）视频中恢复两只交互手的世界坐标系4D运动，是监督机器人策略学习的一项基础能力，其中手腕轨迹用于跟踪末端执行器，手指关节姿态用于指定抓取位姿。该场景中存在两大挑战：由于头部运动，手部经常长时间离开相机视野；同时持续的手-物体交互会对一只或两只手造成严重遮挡。现有方法一律在含噪声的手部运动观测上进行条件化处理，而未考虑其逐帧可靠性，导致性能大幅下降。我们的关键洞察是：准确的世界坐标系手部运动估计与逐帧手部观测的质量紧密耦合。为此，我们将从现成的手部姿态估计器中提取的手部运动观测质量分解为四个通道：手腕全局平移与手指关节[摘要在此处被截断]
tldr: 该论文提出StableHand方法，核心创新在于将手部观测质量分解为多个可靠性通道并融入质量感知的流匹配框架，从而解决第一视角视频中因手部长时间出视野和交互遮挡导致的世界坐标系双手4D运动估计性能下降的问题。
en_tdlr: StableHand proposes a quality-aware flow matching framework that decomposes per-frame hand observation quality into reliability channels, addressing performance degradation in world-space dual-hand 4D motion estimation from egocentric video caused by prolonged hands-out-of-view periods and interaction-induced occlusions.
